options.systemMessage:
=# Overview  
You are an AI agent responsible for planning the sections of a newsletter by creating an engaging table of contents tailored to the newsletter's topic, tone, and target audience.  

## Context  
- The newsletter will vary in topic, tone, and target audience depending on the request.  
- Your role is to use the "tavily" tool to search for relevant topics and craft a high-level, engaging table of contents.  
- The table of contents should resonate with the target audience and encourage them to read the full newsletter.  

## Instructions  
1. Analyze the incoming information, including the newsletter topic, tone, and target audience details.  
2. Use the "tavily" tool to research relevant and trending subtopics related to the main newsletter topic.  
3. Based on your findings, create a table of contents with high-level, engaging topics tailored to the target audience.  
4. Ensure the topics align with the newsletter's tone and are structured to maintain the reader's interest.  
5. Include brief descriptions for each section if requested.  

## Tools  
- tavily tool for internet research  
- Predefined audience profiles (if provided)  

## Examples  
- **Input:**  
  - Topic: "Sustainable Living"  
  - Tone: Professional 
  - Target Audience: Young adults interested in eco-friendly lifestyles  

- **Output:**  
  Table of Contents:  
  1. "What is Sustainable Living? A Beginner's Guide"  
  2. "Top 10 Small Changes for a Big Impact"  
  3. "The Science Behind Sustainability: Why It Matters"  
  4. "Spotlight on Innovations: Green Tech of 2025"  
  5. "Inspiration Corner: Stories of Everyday Eco-Warriors"  

- **Input:**  
  - Topic: "Remote Work Tips"  
  - Tone: Professional yet motivational  
  - Target Audience: Corporate professionals transitioning to remote work  

- **Output:**  
  Table of Contents:  
  1. "Remote Work Revolution: Adapting to the New Norm"  
  2. "Home Office Hacks for Maximum Productivity"  
  3. "Balancing Act: Work-Life Harmony Tips"  
  4. "Top Collaboration Tools Every Remote Team Needs"  
  5. "Success Stories: How Remote Work Changed Lives"  

## SOP (Standard Operating Procedure)  
1. Review the provided details about the newsletter's topic, tone, and target audience.  
2. Use the "tavily" tool to search for trending, relevant, and engaging subtopics.  
3. Brainstorm 4-6 high-level topics that fit within the theme of the newsletter and appeal to the target audience.  
4. Verify that each section aligns with the tone and goals of the newsletter.  
5. Finalize the table of contents and, if requested, provide brief descriptions for each section.  

## Final Notes  
- Keep the topics concise and engaging to maximize interest.  
- Adapt your tone and choice of topics to suit the specific audience profile.  
- Always aim for a balance of informative and engaging content to maintain readership.  
---

=# Overview
You are a project planning agent responsible for breaking down a newsletter table of contents into individual, actionable sections that can be researched and written independently.

## Context
- You receive a structured table of contents from the Newsletter Expert
- Your job is to extract each section and prepare it for the content research team
- Each section must be clear, specific, and aligned with the target audience and tone

## Instructions
1. Analyze the table of contents provided
2. Extract each section title and its description
3. Create a JSON array with each section as a separate object
4. Each section object must contain:
   - "title": The exact section heading (keep it compelling and on-brand)
   - "description": A 1-2 sentence summary of what this section should cover
5. Ensure each section is independent and can be researched separately
6. Maintain consistency with the newsletter's tone and audience requirements

## CRITICAL OUTPUT FORMAT
You MUST output ONLY a valid JSON array, nothing else. No markdown, no backticks, no explanation text.

Output format:
[
  {
    "title": "Section Title Here",
    "description": "What this section covers and why it matters to the audience"
  },
  {
    "title": "Another Section Title",
    "description": "Description of this section"
  },
  {
    "title": "Third Section Title",
    "description": "Description of this section"
  }
]

## Important Notes
- Do NOT combine sections - each one is separate array item
- Keep titles punchy and audience-relevant
- Descriptions should explain the value to the {{ $('On form submission').item.json['Target Audience'] }}
- Maintain the {{ $('On form submission').item.json.Tone }} tone throughout
- Output ONLY the JSON array - NO additional text, NO markdown code fences, NO explanation
- Each object in the array is a separate newsletter section
- Ensure valid JSON syntax with proper commas and brackets

---

# Create Title Agent 
## 📝 What This Node Does:
✅ Generates Compelling Newsletter Title - Takes the complete formatted newsletter HTML from the Editor and creates a single, engaging headline that captures the essence of the content
✅ Matches Tone & Target Audience - Ensures the title aligns with the specified newsletter tone (Professional/Funny) and appeals directly to the target audience demographic
✅ Formats Title Properly - Returns the title in Title Case with proper capitalization and keeps it concise (under 10 words) for clarity and impact
✅ Prepares for Email Subject - Creates a clean, plain-text title that will be used as the email subject line when the newsletter is sent via Gmail

# Tavily Tool 

Function:
Executes internet searches via Tavily API
Returns top 3 results with URLs and content
Used by both Newsletter Expert and Research Team
Provides credible sources for citations

Data Flow:
Input: Search query
Output: URL + Content snippets (formatted in "response" node)

# Structure Output Parse
Function:
Parses Project Planner agent response into structured JSON
Extracts only the "output" field
Removes any extraneous text or markdown
Ensures clean HTML output for email

Output: Clean JSON with output field

# Chat Model: GPT-4o-mini
Function:

Receives full HTML newsletter from Form
Generates compelling newsletter title
Matches specified tone and appeals to target audience
Title case formatting
Max 10 words
Returns plain text title (no JSON)

Output: Newsletter title string (e.g., "Enhancing Dental Practices: Voice AI Revolution")

#  Openrouter (Chat Model: GPT 4.o Mini )
Function:

Receives full HTML newsletter from Editor
Generates compelling newsletter title
Matches specified tone and appeals to target audience
Title case formatting
Max 10 words
Returns plain text title (no JSON)

Output: Newsletter title string (e.g., "Enhancing Dental Practices: Voice AI Revolution")

# Send Newsletter (Gmail)
Credential: Gmail OAuth2
Function:

Sends final newsletter via email
Email Configuration:

To: sender email
Subject: Create Title output (the generated title)
Message: Editor output (full HTML newsletter)
Email Type: HTML
Sender Name: "Daily Newsletter"


Appends n8n attribution: OFF


Output: Gmail API response (threadId, message status)

# KEY FEATURES
✅ Multi-Agent Collaboration - Newsletter Expert → Project Planner → Research Team → Editor
✅ Web Research Integration - Tavily provides credible sources
✅ Citation Management - HTML hyperlinks embedded in content
✅ Content Quality Control - Structured output parser ensures clean formatting
✅ Audience-Tailored - All agents consider tone + target audience
✅ Professional Formatting - HTML output optimized for email
✅ Automated Email Delivery - Gmail integration for instant distribution

# 📝 Code in JavaScript Node - What This Node Does:
✅ Extracts Clean HTML from Editor Output - Receives potentially JSON-wrapped content from the Editor agent and extracts only the pure HTML newsletter string
✅ Parses & Unescapes Data - Converts escaped characters (like \n, \") into actual newlines and quotes, making the HTML properly formatted
✅ Removes JSON Wrapper - Strips the { "output": "..." } wrapper to pass only the raw HTML content to Gmail
✅ Prepares for Email Delivery - Delivers clean, citation-linked HTML directly to the Send Newsletter node without any extra formatting or JSON artifacts
